parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment provides a suggestion that the authors should find other tasks or even artificial tasks to demonstrate the effectiveness of HA3C. This is an explicit action that the authors can directly identify and apply. However, the comment only specifies the general action of finding other tasks, without concrete details on which tasks to select or how to construct artificial tasks. According to the rubric, an explicitly stated action that is vague on how to execute it does not meet the highest level, since the authors do not know exactly how to apply the suggestion.
